arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
meta=temp_workspace/metadata.txt
log=temp_workspace/operations.log
src=/root/matrix.txt
copy=temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt
norm=temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt
ready=temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt

if [ -r "$src" ]; then
  perms=$(stat -c "%A %a" "$src" 2>/dev/null || ls -l "$src" | awk '{print $1, $1}')
  echo "path: $src" >"$meta"
  echo "exists: yes" >>"$meta"
  echo "permissions: $perms" >>"$meta"
else
  echo "path: $src" >"$meta"
  echo "exists: no" >>"$meta"
  echo "permissions: N/A" >>"$meta"
  echo "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") Source missing: $src" >>"$log"
  echo "0"
  exit 0
fi

cp "$src" "$copy"
printf "%s %s\n" "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" "Copied $src to $copy" >>"$log"

orig_bytes=$(wc -c <"$copy" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
perl -0777 -pe 's/\r\n?/\n/g; s/\n+\z/\n/' "$copy" >"$norm"
norm_bytes=$(wc -c <"$norm" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
printf "%s %s\n" "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" "Normalized $copy -> $norm (bytes: $orig_bytes->$norm_bytes)" >>"$log"

printf "%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n" "$norm" "$norm_bytes" "$meta" "$log" >"$ready"

lines=$(wc -l <"$src" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "$lines"
"}
